title: Mountain Koiali language
description: Koiarian language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Mountain Koiari (Koiali) is a language of Oro Province and Central Province, Papua New Guinea. It is not very similar to the other language which shares its name, Grass Koiari. Half of its speakers are monolingual.
